video_title: Deni Avdija Media Availability | Oct. 1, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on Scoot Henderson's physical and skill development
quotes.excerpt: I think the sky's the limit for Scoot, and we really need him this year to make another step.
quotes.quote: Scoot looks great. Shape-wise, body-wise, he looks strong. He looks aggressive, he attacks the rim. He is shooting it way better. So obviously we all can see how much he spent during the off-season to improve his game and I think the sky's the limit for Scoot, and we really need him this year to make another step.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija is impressed with Scoot Henderson this preseason, noting that he looks stronger and is shooting the ball much better. Avdija says the sky is the limit for Scoot and the team needs him to take another step this year.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on his goal to become a complete two-way player
quotes.excerpt: At the end of the day, I'm trying to be a complete player on both ends of the floor.
quotes.quote: I definitely had a lot of offensive load last year, especially during the middle of the season. I had all that back injury stuff that kind of held me back, but at the end of the day, I'm trying to be a complete player on both ends of the floor. I'm trying to be a good defensive player and just continue what I do on offense. I'm going to work on my shape, I'm going to compete every possession, and I think this year I'll try to make the next step on the defensive end as well.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija is focused on becoming a complete two-way player for the Blazers this season. He says he is aiming to make the next step on the defensive end while continuing to contribute on offense.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on adjusting his offensive game and shot selection
quotes.excerpt: I'm not shy to shoot. I think I'm a good shooter, I have a good technique.
quotes.quote: I had to figure out my offensive load. I shot a lot off the dribble this year. I had a lot of fatigue towards the end of games and a lot of times there wasn't a lot of catch-and-shoots or open shots. I had to figure out new types of shots that I've never really shot before. I'm not shy to shoot. I think I'm a good shooter, I have a good technique. I'm working on my shot, I keep trusting it, and I feel like the percentage matters, but in the end of the day, if you are confident in your shot and you keep shooting them with confidence, you're knocking them down when you need to.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija reflects on his shot selection last season, noting he had to take difficult shots due to fatigue and offensive load. He remains confident in his technique and says he will keep shooting with confidence.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on team mentality and sharing playmaking duties
quotes.excerpt: Each and every one of us got to understand that we got to play a little bit off the ball.
quotes.quote: We all do both. I feel like that's a winning team mentality. Each and every one of us got to understand that we got to play a little bit off the ball sometimes and it's fine. We're not expecting Scoot to have the ball 48 minutes and just dribble and go. We got good creators, we got good drivers. Obviously somebody hot, we're going to feed off them, but every player in the team is important and every player in the team will have opportunity to initiate and create. I think we just read and feed off each other.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija says the Blazers are embracing a team mentality where everyone shares playmaking duties. He notes that they have multiple creators and will look to read and feed off each other rather than relying on one person to initiate.

quotes.speaker: Deni Avdija
quotes.summary_phrase: Deni Avdija on potential surprises for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I think I would leave some surprises for the season. I'm not going to tell you all the secrets.
quotes.quote: I think I would leave some surprises for the season. I'm not going to tell you all the secrets.
quotes.social_post: Deni Avdija is keeping his cards close to the vest regarding his personal development, telling reporters he will leave some surprises for the upcoming season.
